query:
-- Test 1: Item counts
SELECT 'dashboard_items' as table_name, COUNT(*) as count FROM dashboard_items
UNION ALL
SELECT 'software_items', COUNT(*) FROM software_items
UNION ALL
SELECT 'systems_items', COUNT(*) FROM systems_items
UNION ALL
SELECT 'decisions', COUNT(*) FROM decisions
UNION ALL
SELECT 'upcoming_reviews', COUNT(*) FROM upcoming_reviews
UNION ALL
SELECT 'milestones', COUNT(*) FROM milestones;

-- Test 2: Bold text check
SELECT 'Bold text items' as test, COUNT(*) as count 
FROM dashboard_items WHERE content LIKE '%**%';

-- Test 3: Hyperlink check
SELECT 'Hyperlink items' as test, COUNT(*) as count 
FROM dashboard_items WHERE content LIKE '%](%';

-- Test 4: Sample data
SELECT 
    SUBSTRING(content, 1, 100) as content_preview,
    CASE WHEN content LIKE '%**%' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END as has_bold,
    CASE WHEN content LIKE '%](%' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END as has_links
FROM dashboard_items 
LIMIT 5;
